summary: Implementation plan for expanding Phonix's Termux-style PRoot Linux workstation capabilities: multi-distro switcher in the Setup Wizard and Distro Hub, enhanced multi-tab interactive terminal with hotkeys and package detection, automatic and manual Phonix desktop shortcuts for Linux CLI/X11 and Android apps, and multi-DE X11 desktop environment switcher (IceWM, XFCE4, Openbox, LXQt).
